HEALER:ADAPT(1)                 Healer Manual                  HEALER:ADAPT(1)

NAME
       healer:adapt — Style DNA consumer and replicator

SYNOPSIS
       /healer:adapt <path/to/StyleDNA.yaml> [--plan-only | --write-components | --full] [--only=<sections>] [--exclude=<sections>] [--copy-voice] [--branding] [--no-page-wipe] [--dry-run] [--report] [--target-root <path>]
       /healer:adapt (-h | --help | ?)

DESCRIPTION
       Style DNA consumer and replicator — takes the Style DNA YAML produced
       by /healer:imitate on a source project and applies it deterministically
       to a target codebase. Where imitate is the encoder (code → StyleDNA),
       adapt is the decoder (StyleDNA → code on a new target). Closes the
       "5-6/10 visual fidelity" gap by replicating page compositions, visual
       motifs, chart render configs, per-icon styles, motion literals, and
       tokens — not just tokens and primitives.

       Validates the Style DNA against its schema, scans the target codebase
       for existing tokens/primitives/pages/icons/motion, computes an
       adaptation plan of AD-NNN decisions, CF-NNN conflicts, and GP-NNN
       gaps, then optionally applies it. Three write modes: --plan-only
       (safe; writes only ADAPTATION_PLAN.md), --write-components (DEFAULT;
       writes tokens + primitives + reusable compositions without touching
       pages), --full (also rewrites target pages to echo source PC-NNN
       compositions). Deterministic: same StyleDNA + same target SHA = same
       plan. Emits ADAPTATION_PLAN.md and ADAPTATION_REPORT.md with per-
       section
       fidelity scores 0-10.

       The Style DNA path is load-bearing: it IS the contract. Every decision
       adapt makes traces to a field in that YAML. Write mode controls blast
       radius: --plan-only is zero-risk preview, --write-components is the
       default safe-apply, --full is the full rewrite. --only/--exclude let
       users stage adaptations section-by-section. --copy-voice and --branding
       are opt-in because a target app is usually not a clone of the source.

OPTIONS
       style_dna_path  (required)
           Path to Style DNA YAML from /healer:imitate

       --plan-only  (optional)
           Emit ADAPTATION_PLAN.md only; no file changes

       --write-components  (optional)
           (DEFAULT) Write tokens + primitives + compositions; skip page
           rewrites

       --full  (optional)
           Also rewrite target pages to echo source PC-NNN compositions

       --only  (optional)
           Comma-separated subset: tokens, motifs, pages, charts, icons,
           branding, copy_voice, ai_response, motion

       --exclude  (optional)
           Subtractive opposite of --only (mutually exclusive with it)

       --copy-voice  (optional)
           Apply CV-NNN microcopy to target (OFF by default)

       --branding  (optional)
           Apply BR-NNN branding assets to target (OFF by default)

       --no-page-wipe  (optional)
           With --full, preserve existing page content inside new composition
           shells

       --dry-run  (optional)
           Print per-file diffs without writing

       --report  (optional)
           Emit ADAPTATION_REPORT.md after apply (default ON unless --plan-
           only)

       --target-root  (optional)
           Explicit target root path (defaults to CWD)

EXAMPLES
       /healer:adapt Prism_StyleDNA_04122026.yaml --write-components --report
           --write-components is the canonical safe-but-substantial use case —
           gets a target to ~7/10 visual fidelity without rewriting its pages.
           Pages stay as-is; the composition templates are imported by the
           user when they want to echo a specific source page composition.
           Trace:
             → Resolves Style DNA path and write mode (write-components, default)
             → Validates YAML against references/ui-styling/style-dna.md schema
             → Scans target codebase for existing tokens/primitives/pages/icons/motion
             → Computes adaptation plan — AD/CF/GP decisions per StyleDNA section
             → Emits ADAPTATION_PLAN.md with per-section applicability table
             → Applies AD-NNN writes — tokens into target config, primitives scaffolded, compositions templates written
             → Emits ADAPTATION_REPORT.md with per-section fidelity scores

       Valid input:    'Prism_StyleDNA_04122026.yaml', 'Prism_StyleDNA_04122026.yaml --plan-only', 'Prism_StyleDNA_04122026.yaml --full --no-page-wipe', 'Prism_StyleDNA_04122026.yaml --only=tokens,motion', 'Prism_StyleDNA_04122026.yaml --exclude=branding,copy_voice', 'Prism_StyleDNA_04122026.yaml --dry-run'
       Invalid input:  'Prism_StyleDNA.yaml --only=tokens --exclude=motion' — --only and --exclude are mutually exclusive
       Invalid input:  'Prism_StyleDNA.yaml --full' — --full is dangerous without review; pair with --no-page-wipe unless you truly want to replace pages
       Invalid input:  'nonexistent.yaml' — Style DNA must exist and pass schema validation

EXIT STATUS
       The command halts (must-pass gate failure) when:
           ! If Style DNA fails schema validation → halt with specific violation
           ! If --full passed without --no-page-wipe and target has uncommitted page changes → warn before proceeding
           ! If --only and --exclude both passed → halt (mutually exclusive)
           ! If target stack cannot express a StyleDNA section (e.g., springs on plain-CSS target) → logged as GP-NNN, not an error

SEE ALSO
       healer:conform, healer:design-review, healer:implement, healer:test,
       healer:push, healer:imitate, healer:design-system

ENFORCEMENT
       Runs under the shared enforcement protocol (shared/_enforcement.md):
       research and verification HARD-GATEs apply.
